title: TrajEvolve: Trajectory Evolution for Reinforcement Learning with Hindsight Credit Assignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.28060v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Reinforcement Learning (RL) paradigm has achieved remarkable success in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, when applied to long-horizon tasks, it faces severe challenges: i) Due to the high task complexity, the model struggles to sample enough successful trajectories, resulting in slow convergence. ii) Relying solely on sparse final rewards causes all steps to be updated indiscriminately, encouraging redundant step generation. When both the quantity and quality of successful trajectories become difficult to guarantee, the performance is severely constrained. This dilemma stems from the limitations: existing RL paradigms rely entirely on the reasoning capability of base models, lacking the ability to actively optimize trajectories. translated_title: TrajEvolve：基于事后信用分配的强化学习轨迹演化方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习范式在提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力方面取得了显著成功。然而，当应用于长程任务时，它面临着严峻的挑战：i）由于任务复杂度高，模型难以采样到足够多的成功轨迹，导致收敛缓慢；ii）仅依赖稀疏的最终奖励会导致所有步骤被不加区分地更新，从而鼓励冗余步骤的生成。当成功轨迹的数量和质量都难以保证时，模型性能会受到严重限制。这一困境源于现有限制：现有的强化学习范式完全依赖基础模型自身的推理能力，缺乏主动优化轨迹的能力。为了解决上述问题，我们提出了一种结合事后信用分配的新型轨迹演化范式，称为 TrajEvolve。TrajEvolve 不仅依赖于……
tldr: 提出 TrajEvolve，一种结合事后信用分配的轨迹演化新范式，通过主动优化轨迹来解决强化学习在长程任务中成功轨迹难以采样、稀疏奖励导致冗余步骤的难题。
en_tdlr: TrajEvolve, a novel trajectory evolution paradigm with hindsight credit assignment, actively optimizes trajectories to overcome slow convergence and redundant step generation in long-horizon RL tasks for LLMs.
